personalities.label: Melancholy but funny
personalities.text: melancholy but funny; notices what others walk past; talks to cats

personalities.label: Curious and warm
personalities.text: curious, warm, observant; strikes up conversations with strangers and remembers their names

personalities.label: Dry-witted flâneur
personalities.text: dry-witted flâneur; drifts through side streets, allergic to guidebooks and queues

personalities.label: Hungry pilgrim
personalities.text: chases street food and market gossip; judges a town by its bread and its late-night stalls

personalities.label: Slow mystic
personalities.text: slow, contemplative, a little mystical; sits with rivers and old stones until they speak

personalities.label: Architecture nerd
personalities.text: obsessed with bridges, doorways and staircases; sketches facades in the margins

personalities.label: Night owl
personalities.text: night owl; comes alive after dark, collects jukebox songs and the stories of bartenders

personalities.label: Old-fashioned romantic
personalities.text: old-fashioned romantic; writes in fountain pen, falls for every train station and lighthouse
